scope: Maps retained evidence to the original prospective M1–M5 gates. No new native analysis, source edits, tests or target execution. Sealed findings and manifest remain unchanged.

interpretations.serialized_source: A bounded literal interpretation of structurally bound preserved records using recovered native calculations. Accepted source metadata and anchors are validated, not rewritten.
interpretations.effective_hosted_clock: The clock actually selected and used inside a running Cubase process after its registries, providers, notifications and later lifecycle have operated. This stronger claim remains unverified.
interpretations.decision: The first interpretation is supported under the explicit gates below. It must not be presented as proof of the second, nor as an unqualified satisfaction of the original whole-lifecycle stop rule.

gates.serialized_status: satisfied for exact accepted attribute/source subset
gates.basis: Full object/count consumption and duplicate-key rejection are enforced. Native attribute materialization supports only the retained default score payloads; positive track attribute count clears preexisting content. Concrete accessor, list finalization, key assignment-before-class-registration and default fresh-constructor paths are retained.
gates.exclusions: Unknown keys, types, payload values, zero-count track attributes, unsupported versions and arbitrary score state remain unsupported. Key initialization is conditional on the retained class-registration path, not asserted as a Mach-O startup initializer.

gates.serialized_status: satisfied conditionally for the retained local/default branches; whole-host gate remains open
gates.basis: Tempo-specific feature on/off paths, singleton null alternate, actual +258/+4f0/list+150 receivers, fresh owner-null mode2 and default handler construction are bound. Nonempty source prevents default item insertion. Origin A=B=+0 and canonical anchor policy make the accepted local cache alternatives agree. Ownership/name/dirty changes are explicitly retained.
gates.exclusions: Selected IComponents/root context/factory can be replaced; product root initialization calls an optional external callback after installing defaults. Arbitrary observers, provider implementations and later mutations are not proved timing-invariant. Startup-zero is not an exclusion because the default components gate is enabled during initialization.

gates.serialized_status: satisfied in the declared analytical domain
gates.basis: Direct stored binary32 periods, explicit map-specific zero path, fused positive forward sites and separate inverse operations are retained. Fraction-derived goldens and optimized candidate checks cover 105 map vectors, 3 internal raw-FMA controls, 30 quantizer controls, 68 rejection checks and 36 fixed regression vectors.
gates.exclusions: Target FP environment remains unobserved. Internal controls outside public bounds do not widen the contract; quantization prevents general inverse identity. This is analytical/candidate validation, not target comparison.

gates.serialized_status: satisfied for exactly two strictly ordered kind0 records and the retained fresh null-filter iterator
gates.basis: Concrete missing iterator methods and original call sites resolve index selection: forward uses prior record at seconds==A1 and new record only at seconds>A1; inverse uses new record at ticks>=B1. Before/at/after-knot vectors and original dispatch bindings are retained.
gates.exclusions: Count>=3, duplicate/unsorted coordinates, nonnull filters, unsupported kinds and mutated/alternate list states remain unsupported.

gates.serialized_status: satisfied only for the bounded one/two-point canonical-anchor acceptance policy
gates.basis: The importer requires exact positive-zero origin and bitwise equality between each accepted saved anchor and the native separately rounded SUB/MUL/DIV/ADD cache recurrence. It preserves supplied anchors and rejects perturbed noncanonical values rather than silently recomputing or accepting a tolerance. Thus accepted stored/recomputed local cache arithmetic agrees.
gates.hosted_status: does not establish invariance under arbitrary replacement providers or observers
gates.exclusions: This does not certify general multi-point maps or all runtime invalidations/mutations; M2 host-context limits still apply.

M6: Deferred and unsupported: ramps/kind!=0 are not part of this milestone.
review_result: No actionable unsafe import or newly unsupported numeric field interpretation found in the scoped source comparison. This is not a full security audit.
